items.name: Peppered Gizzard
items.description: Slow-braised chicken gizzards tossed in fiery scotch bonnet pepper sauce and sweet bell peppers.

items.name: Asun Peppered Goat Meat
items.description: Tender bite-sized grilled goat meat stir-fried in coarsely crushed habanero, onions, and local spices.

items.name: Suya Platter
items.description: Thinly sliced grilled beef skewers seasoned in authentic Yaji spice blend, served with red onions, fresh tomatoes, and cabbage ribbons.

items.name: Beef Suya Skewers
items.description: Four skewers of flame-grilled aged beef chuck glazed with nutty peanut dry rub and ground kanwa.

items.name: Grilled Croaker
items.description: Whole Atlantic croaker charcoal-grilled with our signature Lekki pepper glaze and herb stuffing.

items.name: Smoky Party Jollof with Plantain
items.description: Firewood-infused long grain rice slow-simmered in reduction of plum tomatoes, tatashe, and ginger. Served with caramelized sweet plantain.

items.name: Jollof Rice and Grilled Chicken
items.description: Our signature party jollof served with a quarter herb-marinated grilled chicken leg and crispy coleslaw.

items.name: Native Jollof Rice
items.description: Traditional village rice cooked with palm oil, dried bonga fish flakes, crayfish, locust beans (iru), and shredded scent leaf.

items.name: Efo Riro with Pounded Yam
items.description: Rich Yoruba green vegetable soup cooked with locust beans, smoked panla, assorted meats, and paired with velvety smooth pounded yam.

items.name: Catfish Pepper Soup
items.description: Point-and-kill fresh river catfish simmered in aromatic broth of African nutmeg (ehuru), uda seed, and hot peppers.

items.name: Egusi Soup with Goat Meat and Semo
items.description: Slow-fried melon seed soup folded with fresh bitterleaf and uziza, soft tender goat meat, and served with fluffy semovita.

items.name: Seafood Okro with Eba
items.description: Coarsely chopped fresh okra with tiger prawns, blue crab, and calamari rings in aromatic seafood broth. Served with yellow garri eba.

items.name: Creamy Chicken Linguine
items.description: Al dente linguine pasta tossed in rich garlic parmesan cream sauce, spiced grilled chicken breast strips, and crushed black pepper.

items.name: Seafood Alfredo Pasta
items.description: Fettuccine ribbon pasta with sauteed jumbo prawns, calamari, basil cream, and shaved pecorino cheese.

items.name: Fried Sweet Plantain (Dodo)
items.description: Sweet ripe plantain slices fried to golden perfection with crisp edges and soft honeyed centers.

items.name: Yam Fries with Spicy Pepper Dip
items.description: Thick-cut hand-peeled white yam batons flash-fried crisp, served with our signature house ata din-din relish.

items.name: Coleslaw with Creamy Dressing
items.description: Crunchy shredded green and purple cabbage, carrots, sweet corn kernels, tossed in light tangy mayonnaise dressing.

items.name: Puff-puff (6 pcs)
items.description: Golden Nigerian yeast doughnuts infused with ground nutmeg, fried crisp on the exterior and pillowy soft inside.

items.name: Lemon Cheesecake
items.description: Silky baked citrus cheesecake on spiced butter biscuit crumb base, topped with zesty lemon curd drizzle.

items.name: Warm Chin-Chin Parfait
items.description: Layered Greek yogurt, crushed crunchy vanilla chin-chin crumbles, wild honey drizzle, and fresh passion fruit seeds.

items.name: Signature Chapman
items.description: Classic Lagos cocktail blend of citrus soda, aromatic Angostura bitters, grenadine, cucumber slices, and lemon wheel.

items.name: Chilled Zobo Punch
items.description: Organic dried roselle hibiscus petals steeped with crushed fresh ginger, cloves, pineapple peel, and sweetened with raw cane sugar.

items.name: Fresh Hibiscus Ginger Punch
items.description: Fiery cold-pressed ginger and spiced hibiscus tea over crushed ice with mint sprig garnish.

items.name: Tropical Passion Mocktail
items.description: Sparkling passion fruit puree, lime juice, pineapple reduction, and fresh rosemary sprig.
